query: WITH RECURSIVE ancestors AS ( SELECT id, parent_id FROM mailboxes WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND user_id = $2 AND id = $3 UNION ALL SELECT m.id, m.parent_id FROM mailboxes m JOIN ancestors a ON m.id = a.parent_id WHERE m.tenant_id = $1 AND m.user_id = $2 ) SELECT 1 AS one FROM ancestors WHERE id = $4 LIMIT 1
